body.statement: Can the certified partial procedure in \(\mathrm{def:transducer\text{-}handle}\) be extended by finitely encoded offset-sensitive fixing states, with a computable bound depending only on \(n,L,\gamma\), so that every remaining \(\operatorname{UNKNOWN}\) input is resolved either by one common expression \(F\in\mathcal L_{\mathrm{cyl}}(\mathcal A)\) valid for all compatible refinements or by a rejecting state that directly constructs two final models \(M_0,M_1\in\mathfrak M(H,L,\mathcal A)\) on the unchanged alphabets, with equal laws on \(\Omega_{\mathcal A}\) and unequal target effects?  The extension must include cases where all refinements are individually identifiable but their functionals disagree, and it may not use refinement enumeration, generic elimination, or alphabet-enlarging model gluing.
body.justification: The residual question asks how to resolve every unknown case without alphabet enlargement.
body.gap: No bounded state invariant or direct arbitrary-role countermodel construction is proved.
body.consumer: A resolution would be required before restoring any completeness claim.

obligation.what_is_open: A bounded offset-sensitive fixing extension that resolves every current unknown input by a common finite-cylinder functional or by two directly constructed final fixed-alphabet stationary SCMs.
obligation.obstruction: The available handle contains no finite state encoding, transition invariant, pumping proof, or direct fixed-alphabet model grammar for arbitrary multi-role rejection witnesses. Independent shifting assigns several roles to one coordinate-time slot or enlarges the coordinate alphabet, and per-refinement ID is refuted by the lag-switch collision.
obligation.attempted: The saturated ancestral ADMG gives a sound finite acyclic branch, and the explicit lag-switch tables give one direct cyclic failure. Raw quotient fixing conflates offsets; a general shift lift fails at the fixed-alphabet typing step; and no argument turns disagreement among individually identified refinements into final stationary models without unrestricted enumeration or gluing.
obligation.partial_result: The proved partial normal form is the explicit three-way procedure in \(\mathrm{def:transducer\text{-}handle}\): it terminates within \(4+3^{n\{\gamma+(n-1)L+1\}}\) transitions, returns sound finite-cylinder functionals for the outside witness and every successful saturated-ID call in the acyclic directed-summary subclass, and directly returns the positive stationary fixed-alphabet lag-switch pair with effects \(13/50\) and \(1/2\).  All other inputs return \(\operatorname{UNKNOWN}\); resolving those inputs soundly and completely remains open.
